text:
alyssa: quick heads-up — pushing quant/kernel bundle to night bucket in ~30. staging showed a small perf regression on long sequences, not blocking but visible. thinking we throttle canary and pin if it persists. any objections?

devin: saw the same in last perf run. reg only shows up when seq>2048 and batch>8. might be kv-cache alignment.

meena: fwiw smoke passes on most models. i saw a 4% p99 increase on one LLM profile. attached /logs in the smoke run.

deploybot: deploy request received: engine-quant-2026-04-18 bundle -> night-bucket (slice=5%). preflight checks: imagesigned ✅, checksum ✅, staging-smoke ✅. initiating phased rollout.

jordan: can we start at 1% and ramp to 5%? last time 5% masked issues.

alyssa: yes start 1%, ramp on stable signals. add a throttle to slow ingress if p99 > baseline + 3ms for >5m.

deploybot: updated rollout: start=1%, max=5%, throttle-condition=(p99_delta>3ms for 5m) — will pause and notify #eng-runtime.

meena: if it pauses, plan is to pin traffic to engine:v3.1.9 and roll back bundle. who owns the pin?

devin: ops-bot can pin via the release API. command is: 
```
ops-bot pin-service --service=engine --version=v3.1.9 --reason="quant perf pause"
```

ops-bot: ack. pin command accepted, requires confirm from approver. Approvers list: alyssa, lia, devin.

lia: i'm oncall tonight, confirm ok. but let's not pin unless we have >2% error spikes or sustained p99 drift. i want release notes updated before any pin/rollback.

alyssa: agreed. i'll draft a short RN blurb: "kernel/quant bundle: targeted perf tuning for long-sequence workloads; canarying — may trigger temporary rollback if latency regressions are observed."

jordan: also add a note about fallback policy: requests will fall back to non-quant path for incompatible ops (explicitly kv-cache mismatch). mention potential increased cost during fallback.

meena: collecting traces now — if we see consistent regressions i'll post 2 sample traces here.

deploybot: rollout started at 1% (timestamp: 6623459950). monitoring infra hooks active.

alyssa: thanks — monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/eng-runtime/rollouts/6623456789 — keep pings to channel.

meena: trace snippet: ```
TRACE: engine-quant-2026-04-18 | seq=4096 | batch=12 | kv_miss_ratio=0.18 | p99_delta=7ms
STACK: runtime::matmul -> kernel::quant_matmul -> kv_cache::lookup
```

devin: that's the pattern. if kv_miss_ratio > 0.15 and batch>8 p99 jumps. ops-bot, can we instrument temporary prefix-caching for this canary slice?

ops-bot: instrumentation toggle enabled for slice=1%: prefix_cache=true. Will collect 30m of samples.

alyssa: good. will wait 20m and re-evaluate. if p99 stays > baseline+5ms for 10m we pin and rollback. otherwise continue ramp to 5% after 30m.

lia: agreed on thresholds. i'll be alert. tagging @meena to paste any more traces. :eyes:

meena: will do. also adding a line in rn: "If rollback occurs, we'll revert to engine:v3.1.9 and follow up with a postmortem and corrective kernel patch."

deploybot: monitoring update (6623460001): no errors spike, p99 delta trending down after prefix_cache toggle. ramping to 3% now.

alyssa: nice. hold there for 15m then to 5% if stable. I'll update release notes and close loop with product.

jordan: leaving a short checklist for ops handoff in the RN: - rollout start time, - throttle rule, - pin command & approvers, - trace links, - rollback target version.

alyssa: perfect. closing thread for now, we'll reopen if deploybot pauses or ops-bot triggers pin. :thumbsup:
